entities.name: Phasing of Zhalfir
entities.description: The magical removal of Zhalfir from Dominaria in 4205 AR to protect it from the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: State in northwestern Jamuraa, phased out and later a pocket plane.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Urza's Zhalfirin student who phased out Zhalfir.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planned to let Zhalfir take the brunt of the Phyrexian attack.

entities.name: Queen Wezna
entities.description: Leader of Zhalfir before the invasion.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Inadvertently removed last traces of Zhalfir around 4500 AR.

entities.name: Wrenn and Realmbreaker
entities.description: Performed the New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch around 4562 AR.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane Zhalfir was removed from.

entities.name: Prophecy War
entities.description: War between Zhalfir-aligned city-states and Keld.

events.summary: Teferi and Urza overload a Phyrexian portal over Zhalfir with teleportation magic.
events.quote: Teferi and Urza worked together to destabilize an interplanar portal from Phyrexia

events.summary: Teferi, without Urza's knowledge, uses the released energy to phase out the whole of Zhalfir.
events.quote: Teferi phased out the entire nation of Zhalfir

events.summary: Teferi's act is viewed as a betrayal by Urza and others and he becomes known as the Destroyer of Zhalfir.
events.quote: Teferi became known as the Destroyer of Zhalfir

events.summary: Around 4500 AR Jeska inadvertently removes the last traces of Zhalfir's presence.
events.quote: Jeska inadvertently removed the last traces of Zhalfir's presence

events.summary: Teferi unintentionally arrives on Zhalfir after the Temporal Anchor explosion.

relations.quote: Urza's Zhalfirin student Teferi doubted his homeland would survive.
Zhalfir was led by Queen Wezna
